capabilities.claim: Contract, Preflight, verification, Summary, archive, PR, close, and base-sync governance exists in this repository.
capabilities.limitations: Repository evidence describes this template; it does not prove an adopter executed the lifecycle.

capabilities.claim: The template can inspect project facts and create a profile proposal; it does not prove completed adopter calibration.
capabilities.limitations: Template evidence does not prove completed adopter calibration.

capabilities.claim: An adopter receives the governed entrypoints when the installer completes; installed availability must be checked in the adopter repository.
capabilities.limitations: Installed capability must be verified in the adopter repository.

capabilities.claim: The Runtime provides an adopter-executable, Japanese-default ten-stage calibration Session with pause/resume, review, checks, evidence, and fail-closed Candidate activation.
capabilities.limitations: Template execution evidence does not prove an adopter completed calibration or approval.

capabilities.claim: The template provides a confirmation-gated Installation Wizard for repository detection, New Adoption, Upgrade, Dry Run, and mobile or mixed-stack planning; it does not commit, push, create a PR, or merge.
capabilities.limitations: The wizard does not itself commit, push, create a PR, or merge.

capabilities.claim: The template provides a resumable Calibration Wizard adapter over the ten-stage persisted Session with blocking Unknown and stale evidence, separate human confirmations, and atomic Candidate activation; adopter execution remains required.
capabilities.limitations: Adopter toolchain execution and project-owned approval remain separate evidence.

capabilities.claim: Calibration and readiness consumers share a conservative ten-boundary Inventory with explicit status, provenance, confirmation, staleAt, owner, and blocking reason fields.
capabilities.limitations: Inventory status is evidence compression, not external project execution proof.

capabilities.claim: Calibration Candidate activation is atomic and preserves the previous Active configuration when activation fails.
capabilities.limitations: Atomic activation evidence does not prove a particular adopter activated a Candidate.

capabilities.claim: Bootstrap Adoption has an explicit resumable lifecycle schema, confirmation-gated write phase, and a fail-closed not_claimed readiness boundary.
capabilities.limitations: Bootstrap evidence remains template-local until an adopter records installation facts.

capabilities.claim: An adopter receives a bound per-file ownership manifest with installed/current digests, project modification facts, managed-region evidence, and rollback baseline consumed by the installed lifecycle.
capabilities.limitations: Adopter-installed status requires evidence from the target repository.

capabilities.claim: Installed update proposal/apply and uninstall proposal/state-output boundaries expose reviewable Work Item, snapshot, migration, recalibration, PR handoff, rollback, disable-result, deletion-list, evidence-retention, and receipt-requirement evidence; they do not expose detached filesystem removal or purge execution.
capabilities.limitations: Uninstall proposal and disable write result JSON but do not delete Runtime or update canonical installed state. No public uninstall-facts builder or proposal-digest binding exists. Detached-removal and purge models are not installed; no public detached filesystem-removal or purge entrypoint exists. Target-repository receipts remain required.

capabilities.claim: Quick Install does not yet default to independently verified Release Archive SHA256 evidence.
capabilities.limitations: A source-bound release archive digest check and clean/anonymous install output are not yet recorded.
capabilities.missingEvidence: A source-bound release archive digest check and clean/anonymous install output are not yet recorded.

capabilities.claim: Release and PR claims require independently bound provider Workflow Run, Head SHA, Required Job Names, Conclusions, failure reasons, and artifact evidence before being called verified.
capabilities.limitations: Provider evidence is required for a specific run; repository workflow presence alone is not a published release.

capabilities.claim: Enterprise identity, authorization, isolation, immutable audit, and compliance assurance remain outside AI Cockpit evidence.
capabilities.limitations: Enterprise identity, isolation, immutable audit, and compliance assurance remain outside this repository evidence.
